series.name: Official Samsung PK indoor display codes (partial table + CF FAQ)
series.notes: Official Samsung Pakistan support page 'displayed error codes on indoor unit' (partial, 7+ codes) + CF FAQ. Highest authority for PK. Codes like 'E1 21' are dual-segment display readings.

meaning.en: The indoor filter is dirty enough to reduce airflow, so the display asks for filter cleaning or filter-reset.
meaning.ur: Indoor filter mein itna ghabat ho gaya hai ke airflow kam ho raha hai, is liye display filter cleaning ya filter reset ki khudash maang raha hai.

causes.en: Dust-loaded inner air filters restricting intake
causes.ur: Ghusar se ghusar kar bhare andar ke air filters paani lene ka raasta rok rahe hain

causes.en: Filter-reset reminder not cleared after last cleaning
causes.ur: Last cleaning ke baad filter reset ka reminder clear nahi hua

solutions.en: Remove, brush/vacuum, wash, dry and refit the inner filters
solutions.ur: Andar ke filters nikaal kar brush ya vacuum se saaf karein, dhoyein, sukhaayein aur dobara fit kar dein

solutions.en: Reset the reminder: Operation > Options > Filter Reset > SET (per PK CF FAQ)
solutions.ur: Reminder reset karein: Operation > Options > Filter Reset > SET (PK CF FAQ ke mutabiq)

source.title: Samsung PK error codes page + CF FAQ

notes.en: PK page mixes 'error code' wording but content is a maintenance reminder, not a fault.
notes.ur: PK page 'error code' wali wording use karta hai magar andar mein maintenance reminder hai, fault nahi.

meaning.en: Auto Clean (coil-drying) function is active; odor from the indoor unit is why users notice it.
meaning.ur: Auto Clean (coil drying) function chalta hai; users isay indoor unit se aane wali badbu ki wajah se notice karte hain.

causes.en: Auto Clean cycle enabled from remote/options
causes.ur: Remote ya options se Auto Clean cycle on kar diya gaya hai

causes.en: Residual moisture/odor on indoor coil after cooling
causes.ur: Cooling ke baad indoor coil par namki ya badbu bachi hui hai

solutions.en: Run Auto Clean to completion, or cancel it from the remote
solutions.ur: Auto Clean ko poora chalane dein, ya remote se band kar dein

solutions.en: If odor persists, clean filters and drain area
solutions.ur: Agar badbu bani rahe to filters aur drain area ki safai kare

notes.en: Display font may show Cl/CI depending on panel.
notes.ur: Panel ke mutabiq display font Cl/CI dikha sakta hai.

meaning.en: Heat-mode defrost is running; outdoor coil may steam and indoor fan pauses — normal protection, not a defect.
meaning.ur: Heat mode defrost chalta hai; bahar ke coil se bhaap nikal sakti hai aur kamre wale unit ka fan ruk jata hai — yeh normal protection hai, kharabi nahi.

causes.en: Ice on outdoor heat exchanger during heating
causes.ur: Heating ke doran outdoor heat exchanger par barf

causes.en: Low ambient temperature in heating season
causes.ur: Heating season mein ambient temperature kam ho jana

solutions.en: Wait for the defrost cycle to finish; do not treat as defect
solutions.ur: Defrost cycle khatam hone tak intezaar karein; isay kharabi na samajhein

solutions.en: Defrost ends automatically when Heat mode ends
solutions.ur: Heat mode khatam hote hi defrost khud ba khud khatam ho jata hai

meaning.en: The indoor room-temperature thermistor is open/short or the unit will not start because that reading is invalid.
meaning.ur: Indoor room temperature thermistor khula ya shorted hai ya reading galat hone ki wajah se unit start nahi hota.

causes.en: Failed or drifted room temperature sensor
causes.ur: Room temperature sensor kharab ya reading drift ho gayi

causes.en: Broken/open sensor harness or loose PCB connector (rats commonly cut wires in PK installs)
causes.ur: Sensor harness toota ya khula hai, ya PCB connector dhila hai (PK mein chuhe aksar taar kaat dete hain)

solutions.en: Power-cycle once; if the code returns, contact authorized Samsung service
solutions.ur: Ek baar power cycle karein; code wapas aaye to Samsung ke authorized service se rabta karein

solutions.en: Technician checks/ replaces the room sensor and connector
solutions.ur: Technician room sensor aur connector check karke badalta hai

notes.en: Display loops 'E1' then '21'; newer model years may show 'C1' then '21'. PK page phrase: 'Defective of the room temperature sensor'.
notes.ur: Display 'E1' phir '21' dikhata hai; naye model years mein 'C1' phir '21' bhi ho sakta hai. PK page ka phrase: 'Defective of the room temperature sensor'.

title.en: Indoor heat exchanger temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Indoor heat exchanger temperature sensor kharab

meaning.en: The indoor coil (evaporator/mid) temperature sensor is open/short, so the control stops or refuses to run.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil (evaporator/mid) ka temperature sensor khula/short hai, is liye control ruk jata hai ya chalta hi nahi.

causes.en: Failed indoor heat-exchanger sensor
causes.ur: Indoor heat-exchanger sensor kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Sensor wire cut or connector loose on indoor PCB
causes.ur: Sensor ki wire kat gayi ya indoor PCB par connector dhila ho

solutions.en: Re-seat/repair sensor connector and restart
solutions.ur: Sensor connector dobara baithayein ya marammat karein aur restart karein

solutions.en: Replace sensor if open/short confirmed; escalate to Samsung service if code persists
solutions.ur: Agar khula/short confirm ho to sensor badlein; code wapas aaye to Samsung service se salah lein

notes.en: Corroborated by technician video (RAZA REFRIGERATION) listing rat-damage, loose PCB connector, open sensor, then PCB.
notes.ur: Technician video (RAZA REFRIGERATION) se bhi confirm hota hai jis mein rat-damage, dhila PCB connector, khula sensor aur phir PCB likha gaya hai.

meaning.en: The indoor fan is not rotating at expected speed (motor, capacitor or board drive fault).
meaning.ur: Indoor fan mutabiq speed se nahi ghoom raha (motor, capacitor ya board drive kharabi).

causes.en: Indoor BLDC fan motor failure or stall
causes.ur: Indoor BLDC fan motor kharabi ya jam ho jana

causes.en: Fan capacitor/motor harness fault or indoor PCB drive issue
causes.ur: Fan capacitor/motor harness kharabi ya indoor PCB drive masla

solutions.en: Check for blade jam and clean filters, then restart once
solutions.ur: Fan ki par rukaot check karein aur filters saaf karein, phir ek baar restart karein

solutions.en: Authorized service replaces motor/capacitor or repairs PCB
solutions.ur: Authorized service motor/capacitor badle ya PCB ki marammat kare

notes.en: Samsung India confirms E1+54 loop = E154 fan motor/capacitor. SplitAtlas treats C154 as indoor fan error (same number family).
notes.ur: Samsung Ind. ne confirm kiya hai ke E1+54 loop = E154 fan motor/capacitor. SplitAtlas C154 ko indoor fan error maanta hai (wahi number family).

meaning.en: Main control board EEPROM content is incorrect, deleted or the option code was never set properly.
meaning.ur: Main control board ka EEPROM data galat ya mita hua hai ya option code theek tareeqe se set nahi hua.

causes.en: Corrupted or blank EEPROM data on indoor main board
causes.ur: Indoor main board ka EEPROM data kharab ya khali

causes.en: Missing option-code setup after board replacement
causes.ur: Option code ki setup nahi hui, sirf board badla gaya

solutions.en: Power-cycle once; if it returns, technician re-enters option code / rewrites EEPROM
solutions.ur: Ek baar power cycle karein; wapas aaye to technician option code dobara likhe ya EEPROM rewrite kare

solutions.en: Authorized Samsung service board repair or replacement
solutions.ur: Authorized Samsung service board ki marammat ya replacement

notes.en: Newer Gulf/India pages word this as 'C1 or 63' with 'incorrect or deleted EEPROM data'.
notes.ur: Naye Gulf/India pages par isay 'C1 or 63' likha gaya hai 'incorrect or deleted EEPROM data' ke sath.

meaning.en: Indoor coil sensor reading is shorted or open; sensor may have come off the coil.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil sensor ki reading short ya khuli hai; sensor coil se gir bhi sakta hai.

causes.en: Indoor heat exchanger sensor short
causes.ur: Indoor heat exchanger sensor mein short

causes.en: Indoor heat exchanger sensor open / detached from coil
causes.ur: Indoor heat exchanger sensor khula ya coil se alag ho gaya

solutions.en: Check that the sensor is seated on the indoor exchanger; refit or replace
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sensor indoor exchanger par baitha hua hai; dobara lagayein ya badlein

solutions.en: If wiring is fine, authorize service for sensor replacement
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek hai to service karwayein aur sensor badlein

notes.en: PK page solution text says 'exchanger sensor departure of the indoor unit'.
notes.ur: PK page ke solution mein likha hai 'exchanger sensor departure of the indoor unit'.

meaning.en: Outdoor coil sensor reading is shorted or open.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil sensor ki reading short ya khuli hai.

causes.en: Outdoor heat exchanger sensor short
causes.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger sensor mein short

causes.en: Outdoor heat exchanger sensor open / connector corroded
causes.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger sensor khula ya connector mein zang

solutions.en: Inspect outdoor sensor fitment and connector; refit or replace
solutions.ur: Outdoor sensor aur connector ki fitting dekhein; dobara lagayein ya badlein

solutions.en: Book authorized service if code persists
solutions.ur: Agar code barta rahe to authorized service book karein

notes.en: PK page body once said 'indoor unit' by copy-paste error but cause list clearly says outdoor heat exchanger sensor.
notes.ur: PK page ke body mein ek baar ghalat copy-paste se room ki unit likha tha magar cause list saaf kehti hai ke yeh bahar ke heat exchanger sensor hai.

meaning.en: The heater/auxiliary temperature sensor is open or short (heat-pump or electric-assist models).
meaning.ur: Heater/auxiliary temperature sensor khula ya short hai (heat-pump ya electric-assist models).

causes.en: Heater temperature sensor short
causes.ur: Heater temperature sensor mein short

causes.en: Heater temperature sensor open / disconnected
causes.ur: Heater temperature sensor khula ya disconnected

solutions.en: Check heater sensor seating and wiring; replace if needed
solutions.ur: Heater sensor ki jagah aur wiring check karein; zaroorat ho to badlein

solutions.en: Contact authorized Samsung service
solutions.ur: Authorized Samsung service se rabta karein

notes.en: Only on heat models with that sensor; PK page lists it with E5/E6.
notes.ur: Sirf un heat models par jo us sensor ke sath aate hain; PK page isay E5/E6 ke sath list karta hai.
